name: Temperament
overview: Scripture reveals that our temperament, shaped by the work of the Holy Spirit, is part of God's ongoing transformation within us. Jesus invites those who are burdened to come to Him for rest, highlighting His gentle and compassionate nature toward our struggles. Confident in God's faithfulness, believers can trust that He who began this work in us will faithfully complete it, refining our character and temperament until Christ's return.
